question:
A series LCR circuit has $L = 0.10\text{ H}$ and $C = 10\ \mu\text{F}$.
(i) Calculate the resonant frequency of the circuit.
(ii) Explain how an oscillating current in such a circuit is related to the production of electromagnetic waves. If electromagnetic waves of this frequency travel in vacuum, calculate their wavelength.

options.A:
(i) $f_0=\dfrac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}=159\text{ Hz}$.
(ii) Oscillating current contains accelerating charges that produce time-varying electric and magnetic fields, which can propagate as electromagnetic waves. $\lambda=\dfrac{3.0\times10^8}{159}=1.89\times10^6\text{ m}$.
options.B:
(i) $f_0=15.9\text{ Hz}$.
(ii) A constant current produces electromagnetic waves, and $\lambda=1.89\times10^7\text{ m}$.
options.C:
(i) $f_0=159\text{ Hz}$.
(ii) Electromagnetic waves are produced only by stationary charges, and $\lambda=1.89\times10^4\text{ m}$.
options.D:
(i) $f_0=1.59\times10^3\text{ Hz}$.
(ii) Oscillating current produces a constant magnetic field only, and $\lambda=1.89\times10^5\text{ m}$.
